description: Questions about docgen's own code, each with the files a good search should find. Run: python -m docgen.evaluate evals/docgen.json

questions.question: How are public GitHub repos cloned and kept up to date?

How is a Python file split into chunks for the search index?
How does the search index decide which files need to be embedded again?
Where is the Mermaid diagram checked and repaired?
How is the hub written out as Markdown README files?
How does the web UI run a hub build in the background and let the user stop it?
What happens when Claude refuses a request or the reply hits the token limit?
How does docgen talk to a local Ollama server?
How are generated docstrings inserted into Python source files?
How does the docstring generator follow the call graph to gather context?
Where are FastAPI and Flask endpoints detected?
What embedding is used offline in tests instead of the real model?
